claims: Venezuela and Italy will face each other in the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinals.
Venezuela and Italy semifinal game is on Monday, March 16, 2026.
Venezuela and Italy semifinal game is at loanDepot Park in Miami.
Venezuela and Italy semifinal matchup is set for Monday night at 8:00 p.m. ET.
Italy's 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal appearance is its first-ever.
Venezuela's 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal appearance is its first since 2009.
Venezuela advanced to the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinals by defeating Japan 8-5 in the quarterfinals.
Japan is the defending champion of the World Baseball Classic.
Wilyer Abreu hit a three-run home run for Venezuela in the quarterfinals against Japan.
Maikel Garcia hit a two-run home run for Venezuela in the quarterfinals against Japan.
Italy reached the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinals after defeating Puerto Rico 8-6.
Italy is unbeaten in the 2026 World Baseball Classic with a 5-0 record.
Venezuela and Italy semifinal game will be broadcast on FS1 in the United States.
Venezuela and Italy most recently met in football in a March 2024 friendly.
Italy won the March 2024 friendly against Venezuela 2-1.
The first-ever meeting between Venezuela and Italy national football teams occurred on March 21, 2024.
The first-ever Venezuela vs Italy football match was at Chase Stadium in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
On March 21, 2024, Italy defeated Venezuela 2-1 in an international friendly.
Mateo Retegui scored for Italy in the 40th minute against Venezuela on March 21, 2024.
Mateo Retegui scored for Italy in the 80th minute against Venezuela on March 21, 2024.
Darwin Machís scored for Venezuela in the 43rd minute against Italy on March 21, 2024.
Mateo Retegui scored twice for Italy in the March 21, 2024 match against Venezuela.
Darwin Machís scored Venezuela's lone goal in the March 21, 2024 match against Italy after a mistake by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
Gianluigi Donnarumma saved a penalty attempt from Salomón Rondón early in the March 21, 2024 match against Venezuela.
More than 300,000 Italians emigrated to Venezuela in the 1940s and 1950s.
Baseball remains Venezuela's most popular sport.
Venezuela's national football team is called "La Vinotinto".
Venezuela's national football team has never qualified for a FIFA World Cup.
